fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. Your jaws close for 26 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Bank Ambush
fusions.desc: You lunge to a target up to 5 tiles away and snap, dealing 14 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Eyes Above Water
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 65% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Nothing Slips Out
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, your damage rises by 12%.
